prompt: By the time the rescue team reached them, the climbers ___ (wait) in the snow for six hours.
explanation: for six hours mide la duración acumulada antes de que llegara el equipo de rescate.

prompt: The pavement was wet because it ___ (rain) steadily since dawn.
explanation: El pavimento mojado era el resultado pasado de una actividad prolongada.

prompt: When the review began, the analysts ___ (not / monitor) the system for very long.
explanation: La negativa coloca not después de had: had not been monitoring.

prompt: How long ___ (she / rehearse) before the curtain went up?
explanation: How long pregunta por la duración anterior; had va delante del sujeto.

prompt: His hands were covered in paint because he ___ (decorate) the flat all morning, but only one wall was finished.
explanation: La pintura en las manos era el resultado visible de la actividad anterior.

prompt: The engine failed at noon; it ___ (not / run) smoothly for several days.
explanation: for several days expresa una situación prolongada previa al fallo del motor.

prompt: ___ (the engineers / test) the new material for long when the alarm sounded?
explanation: La interrogativa se forma con Had + sujeto + been + verbo en -ing.

prompt: The laboratory had been storing the samples at the correct temperature before the alarm sounded.
solution: The laboratory had not been storing the samples at the correct temperature before the alarm sounded.
explanation: Para negar, se añade not entre had y been.

prompt: The researchers had been tracking the whale for six months before the tag failed.
solution: Had the researchers been tracking the whale for six months before the tag failed?
explanation: Had pasa delante del sujeto; been y la forma en -ing no cambian.

prompt: By 9 p.m., Marta had been editing the documentary for four hours.
explanation: for four hours acumula duración hasta el punto pasado marcado por by 9 p.m.

prompt: The players were exhausted because they had been training in the heat all afternoon.
explanation: El agotamiento era el resultado pasado de una actividad prolongada.

prompt: Before the replacement crew arrived, the workers had been repairing the bridge for eight hours.
explanation: La reparación duró ocho horas antes de otro hecho pasado; se destaca el proceso, no su finalización.

prompt: They ___ (wait) for an hour before the bus came.
I ___ (work) all day before I went home.
She ___ (not / feel) well for several weeks.
___ he ___ (run) before the race started?
We ___ (look) for the keys until then.
The machine ___ (make) a strange noise before it stopped.
You ___ (study) since early morning before the exam.
Sam had been travelling for three weeks before he returned.
solution: Sam had not been travelling for three weeks before he returned.
explanation: El auxiliar y la forma verbal muestran la estructura de este tiempo verbal.

prompt: They had been building the bridge all year.
solution: Had they been building the bridge all year?
explanation: El auxiliar y la forma verbal muestran la estructura de este tiempo verbal.

prompt: I had been waiting since dawn.
solution: I had not been waiting since dawn.
explanation: El auxiliar y la forma verbal muestran la estructura de este tiempo verbal.

prompt: The ground was wet because it had been raining all night.
explanation: El marcador temporal y el contexto indican Past Perfect Continuous.

prompt: She had been teaching there for ten years before she moved.
explanation: El marcador temporal y el contexto indican Past Perfect Continuous.
